purpose: MiniMax M3 provider contract for Hermes runtime. Documents the canonical MiniMax provider name, endpoint mode, model spelling, key environment contract, and Paperclip profile shape that T03 will prove via a clean direct Hermes session. Side-effect-free planning artifact: the actual direct invocation against the MiniMax endpoint is gated by the prerequisite upgrade verification (T02 phase_verdict=UPGRADE_VERIFIED_PENDING_MINIMAX_REGISTRY + 6/6 pre-flight PASSED + 4/4 patch reconciliation RECONCILED) and by explicit operator confirmation (LFP-LF-02).

trigger_conditions: any MiniMax PyPI provider release or naming convention change
any mutation of M014-S05-hermes-upgrade.json phase_verdict away from UPGRADE_VERIFIED_PENDING_MINIMAX_REGISTRY
any change to /paperclip/hermes-runtime on the live VPS without going through the hermes-rollback path
any change to the MiniMax API base URL or key environment contract
any decision to swap MiniMax M3 for a different model (per upstream release notes M3 is the canonical target)
any change to the Paperclip adapterConfig.hermesLocal.minimaxProfile block
any new doc on the MiniMax API contract that changes auth header shape or request schema

prerequisite_state_for_T03.policy: This contract enumerates the upgrade.json state that T03 requires BEFORE live execution. In the auto-mode execution lane, T02 produced upgrade.json with phase_verdict=PLAN_READY_LIVE_EXECUTION_DEFERRED (NOT UPGRADE_VERIFIED_PENDING_MINIMAX_REGISTRY), so T03 records the prerequisite gate but the actual live execution is deferred to an operator-confirmed session.
prerequisite_state_for_T03.gate_satisfied_rationale: T02 phase_verdict is PLAN_READY_LIVE_EXECUTION_DEFERRED (auto-mode lane cannot execute live VPS readback or pip install); therefore T03 cannot satisfy prerequisite_state_for_T03 in the auto-mode lane and records the contract only.

minimax_provider_registry_target.policy: The target state of the Hermes provider registry AFTER T03 direct execution succeeds. T03 introduces the MiniMax provider into the registry; T04 swaps it into the primary slot of the Paperclip adapter config. The registry carries three providers total: xiaomi (deprecation gated by T04 success), openai-codex (preserved fallback), and minimax (new MiniMax M3 binding).

providers_target.evidence_pointer: This contract; live verification deferred to operator session
providers_target.current_live_state: contract-only; NOT in the live registry until T03 live execution succeeds

canonical_minimax_provider_name.policy: Single canonical name used in the Hermes CLI --provider flag and in the Paperclip adapterConfig.hermesLocal.minimaxProfile.provider field. Must match exactly across hermes-paperclip wrapper args, upstream hermes --list-providers output, and Paperclip adapterConfig.

canonical_name_alternates_considered.name: MiniMax
canonical_name_alternates_considered.rejected_reason: Mixed-case; would break grep-on-config invariants and downstream BOS agent dispatch tables that use lowercase provider keys

canonical_name_alternates_considered.name: minimax-m3
canonical_name_alternates_considered.rejected_reason: Provider / model split: provider name is the registry slot key, model is the model identifier within the provider slot

canonical_name_alternates_considered.name: minimax-ai
canonical_name_alternates_considered.rejected_reason: Vendor brand ('MiniMax') is not the provider; provider is the registry entry that maps to one outbound endpoint. Using brand in provider name risks future brand-model coupling

canonical_name_alternates_considered.name: minimax-m3-only
canonical_name_alternates_considered.rejected_reason: Future MiniMax M4/M5 models would require provider rename; provider names should be vendor-stable

canonical_minimax_provider_name.canonical_name_rationale: Lowercase, vendor-stable, model-agnostic. Matches the hermes-agent convention of using the upstream provider registry key (xiaomi, openai-codex) as the --provider flag value. Avoids case-mismatch drift between config, CLI, and Paperclip adapter.

canonical_endpoint_mode.policy: Hermes provider endpoint mode (how hermes-paperclip talks to the outbound API). The MiniMax endpoint exposes an OpenAI-compatible chat completions surface, so the endpoint mode mirrors the xiaomi primary provider.

endpoint_mode_alternates_considered.rejected_reason: MiniMax API surface is OpenAI-compatible chat completions, not Anthropic Messages; choosing anthropic-messages would force a non-existent client implementation
Custom curl mode is for non-OpenAI vendors; MiniMax exposes a documented chat completions surface so the openai-compatible client is the right fit
codex-cli-local is for the openai-codex fallback that uses the Codex CLI subprocess; MiniMax is a hosted API

canonical_endpoint_mode.endpoint_mode_rationale: MiniMax exposes an OpenAI-compatible chat completions API (verified via the MiniMax developer docs schema: POST /v1/chat/completions with bearer auth and standard OpenAI message schema). The hermes-agent openai-compatible client handles auth, request shaping, streaming, and tool calls; no custom client needed.

canonical_model_spelling.policy: Exact model identifier string passed via --model flag and stored in Paperclip adapterConfig. Must match the upstream MiniMax API model name verbatim.

model_spelling_alternates_considered.rejected_reason: Too short; collides with the existing 'mimo-v2.5-pro' prefix in dispatch tables. MiniMax-M3 disambiguates vendor from model
Lowercase prefix is wrong case; the upstream model identifier is published with the canonical 'MiniMax' brand prefix and a hyphen to M3 (per MiniMax developer docs API reference)
Date-suffixed model names are appropriate for snapshot models; M3 is the stable model family name, not a specific dated snapshot
Double-prefix is a typo; the canonical name is one MiniMax brand prefix + M3 model suffix

canonical_model_spelling.model_spelling_rationale: Matches the MiniMax developer docs published model identifier verbatim. The case-sensitive spelling is required for the OpenAI-compatible client to resolve the model on the MiniMax backend; a case-mismatch returns 404 model_not_found.
canonical_model_spelling.model_spelling_source_pointer: MiniMax developer docs -> Models reference (verified by fetch_page on https://platform.MiniMax.io/docs/models in T01 baseline freshness_posture)

key_environment_contract.policy: Environment variables that the openai-compatible client reads at runtime. The MiniMax binding follows the same shape as the Xiaomi binding: one auth key (bearer) + one base URL (endpoint host). The values are passed through Paperclip secret_ref envelope (LHA-SECRET-REF-ENVELOPE) so the adapter never sees the resolved values in rendered adapterConfig.

key_contract_alternates_considered.shape: single env var MINIMAX_API_KEY only (base URL hardcoded in hermes-agent upstream)
key_contract_alternates_considered.rejected_reason: Hardcoding the base URL in upstream hermes-agent breaks portability between MiniMax staging and production endpoints, and forces a hermes-agent code patch every time the MiniMax base URL changes. The xiaomi binding uses two secret refs for the same reason.

MiniMax uses a single bearer token model per the OpenAI-compatible chat completions contract; splitting into bearer+tenant would require a custom client and adds no security value (tenant gating is handled by the bearer token scope itself).
Versioned env var names are appropriate for breaking auth contract changes. The current MiniMax bearer auth contract is stable; versioning the env var names adds friction without benefit.

key_environment_contract.key_contract_rationale: Mirrors the Xiaomi xiaomi binding shape (auth + base URL as two separate secret_ref env vars) so the Paperclip adapter config diff is minimal: only XIAOMI_API_KEY -> MINIMAX_API_KEY and XIAOMI_BASE_URL -> MINIMAX_BASE_URL. Same secret_ref envelope shape (LHA-SECRET-REF-ENVELOPE) is preserved by construction.

paperclip_minimax_profile_shape.policy: The Paperclip adapterConfig.hermesLocal block that will be applied in T04 (T03 only documents the contract shape; T04 mutates the live adapter config under operator confirmation).

profile_shape.session_id_format_expected: YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_<6hex> (same shape as xiaomi/openai-codex per upstream hermes-agent)

paperclip_minimax_profile_shape.xiaomi_profile_deprecation_gating: xiaomi/mimo-v2.5-pro profile is NOT removed by T03 (auto-mode lane cannot mutate adapter config); deprecation is gated by T04 live adapter config flip succeeding and a clean Paperclip session on the minimax profile
paperclip_minimax_profile_shape.openai_codex_profile_role_after_T03: fallback-only; openai-codex/gpt-5.3-codex stays as the fallback provider, never as the primary

pre_direct_cleanup.policy: Pre-execution cleanup that the live executor MUST perform before starting a clean MiniMax M3 run. Each step MUST be recorded in direct-proof.json with exit code + timestamp.

checks.name: verify_no_xiaomi_session_active
checks.expected_output_shape: exit code 1 (no match) — there must be no active Xiaomi Hermes session
checks.rationale: Per task plan: 'terminate Xiaomi sessions' before starting clean MiniMax run

checks.name: verify_minimax_secret_refs_resolvable
checks.command: Paperclip secret-store resolution check on MINIMAX_API_KEY and MINIMAX_BASE_URL (Paperclip admin API; never echoes resolved values)
checks.expected_output_shape: exit code 0 AND resolved: true for both MINIMAX_API_KEY and MINIMAX_BASE_URL
checks.pass_criteria: both secret_refs resolve successfully (resolver returns success without exposing the value)
checks.rationale: Per task plan: 'Supply the existing GSD-held access through a secret reference'

checks.name: verify_clean_session_startup
checks.expected_output_shape: stdout contains 'Hermes Agent v0.18.2 (2026.7.8.1)' AND 'minimax' is listed as a known provider
checks.pass_criteria: exit code 0 AND version label match AND minimax in provider list
checks.rationale: Per task plan: 'start a clean Hermes session' — confirms runtime version + provider registry state

post_direct_validation_requirements.policy: Validation requirements that the direct-proof.json MUST satisfy before phase_verdict can be promoted to PASS. Each requirement maps to a downstream validator check (V-HM-DI-13 .. V-HM-DI-19).

terminal_status_requirement.description: hermes-paperclip invocation against MiniMax MUST exit with code 0

structured_output_requirement.description: resultJson.bos MUST be present in stdout and parse as a JSON object with at minimum keys {session_id, resultJson} where resultJson.bos is the BOS-shaped payload
structured_output_requirement.expected_shape: stdout JSON object with top-level keys session_id + resultJson; resultJson.bos is a BOS-shaped object

endpoint_class_requirement.description: The MiniMax invocation MUST use the openai-compatible endpoint class — NOT codex-cli-local (which would route through Codex CLI, not MiniMax)

provider_name_requirement.description: The MiniMax invocation MUST use --provider=minimax (canonical lowercase) — NOT MiniMax / minimax-m3 / any other casing

model_spelling_requirement.description: The MiniMax invocation MUST use --model=MiniMax-M3 (canonical mixed-case spelling) — NOT M3 / minimax-m3 / etc.

xiaomi_endpoint_reuse_prohibition.description: The MiniMax invocation MUST NOT route through any xiaomi endpoint or use any XIAOMI_API_KEY / XIAOMI_BASE_URL secret

credential_redaction_requirement.description: The captured stdout MUST NOT contain any MINIMAX_API_KEY= / MINIMAX_BASE_URL= value, Bearer token, sk-* / tp-* token shape

session_id_correlation_requirement.description: The session_id in stdout MUST be a fresh YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_<6hex> value that does not appear in any prior runtime evidence (proves no replay of an old session)
